svg.title: Atlas Windows configuration pipeline architecture
svg.desc: Pipeline architecture for Atlas: a YAML-defined playbook applies ordered configuration stages to Windows — default settings, services, components, appx packages, start menu, then grouped tweaks (privacy, performance, networking, debloat, security, QoL). Each stage runs commands, PowerShell scripts, registry imports, service changes, scheduled-task changes, or file operations before the next stage continues.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the starting state before the Atlas pipeline runs?')
g.text: Unmodified OS — input to the pipeline

svg.text: Stage group 1 — src/playbook/Configuration/atlas/ · ordered configuration filters
